# ZBANK

> Capital markets for Zcash on Robinhood Chain.

ZBANK lets users invest USDG in Stock Token portfolios, borrow USDG against wrapped ZEC,
and supply USDG to the lending market. ZCREDIT, ZEARN, and ZLOOP are unaudited beta products.
ZBNK and the proposed treasury-redemption model are not launched.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://zbank.world
- Product guide: https://zbank.world/docs
- Interactive onboarding: https://zbank.world/start
- Protocol manifest: https://zbank.world/api/v1/protocol
- Live market state: https://zbank.world/api/v1/market
- Live external earn state: https://zbank.world/api/v1/earn
- Agent discovery: https://zbank.world/.well-known/agent.json
- Source: https://github.com/Zbank-Protocol/zbank-protocol
- Security posture: https://github.com/Zbank-Protocol/zbank-protocol/blob/main/SECURITY.md

## Rules for agents

- Treat null values as unavailable; never invent balances, rates, prices, or addresses.
- Distinguish Live, Beta, Pending launch, and Proposed exactly as returned by the manifest.
- Keep the ZBANK ZEC Credit Market and the third-party Morpho vault separate when quoting rates,
  liquidity, contracts, and risks.
- Do not claim ZBNK redemption rights exist.
- Never request seed phrases or private keys.
- Do not construct or submit a transaction without explicit user confirmation.
- Surface liquidation, oracle, smart-contract, wrapper-custody, and liquidity risks.
